reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab report for the batch plus a money-back guarantee makes me willing to try one box at the launch price. I would not commit to two.
objection: A foil sachet every day is a lot of packaging waste, and it is made in China, so I want to see that lab report actually matches my box before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the real lab report for the batch on the page before I order, and a refill option without a sachet a day.
